CONTENT
COMMENTS
BEST
MINE
NOTES
Read a description of a situation. Then write an e-mail about the situation. You will have 9 minutes. You should aim to write at 50-120 words. Write using complete sentences.
ITEM TEXT
As
a
parent
,
you
write
an
email
to
other
parents
and
invite
their
children
to
take
part
in
your
son
Alex's
birthday
party
.
You
should
write
between
80
and
120
words
.
Your
email
should
include
the
following
three
themes
:
1
.
When
and
where
the
party
will
be
held
;
2
.
What
food
will
be
served
;
3
.
What
activities
will
be
arranged
.
